project.description:
Performs one of the following actions:
- LIST: Lists all S3 object versions (including delete markers) in a clean table format. - FETCH: Promotes a specific version of an object to the latest by copying it back to the same key.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: ACTION
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: - LIST: View all available versions of an S3 object. - Fetch: Download a specific version of an object to a local path.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: KEY
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: full object key path in bucket

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: VERSION_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: VERSION_ID to rollback. Hint: Use LIST to find what you are looking for.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
# Assume role aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds 1800 \ --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl \ --role-session-name "s3-fetch-restore" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g') export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g') export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed 's/[ ,"]//g')
if [[ "$ACTION" == "LIST" ]]; then echo -e "\nListing versions for s3://$BUCKET/$KEY...\n" aws s3api list-object-versions \ --bucket "$BUCKET" \ --prefix "$KEY" \ --query "Versions[?Key=='$KEY']" \ --output table
elif [[ "$ACTION" == "FETCH" ]]; then if [[ -z "$VERSION_ID" ]]; then echo "VERSION_ID required for FETCH" exit 1 fi
echo -e "\nAttempting server-side promotion via copy-object...\n"
if aws s3api copy-object \ --bucket "$BUCKET" \ --key "$KEY" \ --copy-source "${BUCKET}/${KEY}?versionId=${VERSION_ID}"; then
echo "Version $VERSION_ID promoted via server-side copy." else echo -e "\nFalling back to download and re-upload due to size or limitation...\n"
TMP_FILE="/tmp/$(basename "$KEY")"
aws s3api get-object \ --bucket "$BUCKET" \ --key "$KEY" \ --version-id "$VERSION_ID" \ "$TMP_FILE"
aws s3 cp "$TMP_FILE" "s3://$BUCKET/$KEY" rm -f "$TMP_FILE"
echo "Version $VERSION_ID promoted via re-upload." fi
else echo "ERROR: Invalid ACTION: $ACTION" exit 1 fi
# Cleanup unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN rm -f assume-role-output.txt
